name: ECON 2491W
title: Internship Research Paper
description: Research paper of 3,000-4,000 words on approved topic related to the internship field study.
requirement_description: 9 credits of 2000-level or above ECON (6 may be concurrent); at least 6th semester with a min CGPA of 2.25 or a min of 2.5 in 2000-level or above ECON courses; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
